preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of main roads M must be between 0 and 120,000.
Each main road must connect two valid city nodes.
The starting position S must be a valid city node.

postconditions.description: The output must contain N-1 space-separated integers representing the shortest distances.
All distances must be non-negative integers.
The output must be the sorted list of distances in ascending order based on vertex number.
